tooltip: Short walks to Sun Plaza, Fansipan and the town center suit exploration, though some rooms sit up a hill with stairs to town and easy Grab access.

name: Great view
tooltip: Mountain and valley views feature from many rooms and the breakfast area, with guests spotting the train and Muong Hoa monorail and recommending higher floors for better vistas.

name: Excellent room comfort & quality
tooltip: Beds and overall room comfort draw praise for being wide and comfortable, and several guests highlight roomy, restful sleeping arrangements.

name: Top rated room amenities
tooltip: In-room amenities include USB sockets, aircon and smart TVs with Netflix, and guests note an uncommon in-room fire/escape mask as a safety touch.

name: Sparkling clean
tooltip: Rooms and public areas stay spotless, with guests calling the property 'spotlessly clean' and noting fresh, new fittings.

name: Professional guest services
tooltip: Staff offer hot tea on arrival, carry luggage, help buy bus tickets, call taxis and contact bus companies, and stay attentive and friendly throughout stays.

name: Great breakfast
tooltip: Breakfast receives consistent praise for taste and value, with options like free omelettes and set breakfasts priced around 100,000–150,000 VND.

name: Great breakfast

name: Top value

name: Attentive host service

name: Well-appointed bathrooms
tooltip: Bathrooms are described as spacious, clean, and in some rooms include a nice en-suite or separate shower.
